name: Redd Riot
bio: Maniac. Bandit. Menace. These are the nicest epithets attributed to anti-stealth master criminal, Redd Riot. Exiled from Stoneloom for her innumerable crimes, she now plunders the world over, in the hopes of one day raising enough cash to start her own kingdom. Guarded by minigun-wielding underlings. And with only one law – what Redd says, goes.
